A SHORT STORY

接住流星 的那個晚上 The Night She Caught a Shooting Star

The Night She Caught a Shooting Star 接住流星的那個晚上

一個關於許願、手套、與十塊錢的故事 a story of wishes, gloves, and ten dollars

一I
找工作的日子Job-Hunting Days

她是一位大學剛畢業的新鮮人，她在找工作。每天投履歷找工作，都沒有公司回她，都沒有下文。她就一天比一天緊張，一天比一天沒自信。

She was a fresh college graduate, out looking for work. Every single day she sent out résumés — and every single day, nothing. No replies. No call-backs. Not a single company wrote back. With every passing day she grew a little more anxious, a little less sure of herself.

第 一 章 Chapter I
2

二II
來不及許願的流星The Wish That Got Away

然後呢，有一天她決定：「啊，今天休息一下好了，太累了，今天不要再找工作投履歷了，今天去天母棒球場看個棒球比賽。」她坐在觀眾席上面，看著棒球比賽。有一顆高飛球被打出去，然後有個外野手跑跑跑，要準備去接的時候呢，全場都在看那顆高飛球。飛在空中的時候呢，那個瞬間同時有一顆流星從天空中劃過，咻一下劃過去，太快了！她剛剛看到那顆流星出現的時候呢，來不及許願，那顆流星就消失了。她就覺得：「哎呀好可惜啊！剛剛如果這顆流星出現的時候有許願就好了，來不及許願真可惜。」她就想說：「如果流星出現之前可以通知我的話，可以先收到通知的話，那該有多好？」然後呢，她看那個接高飛球的外野手啊，跑跑跑跑跑接住那顆棒球啊。她就想說：「哇，如果流星飛過來跟高飛球飛過來一樣，可以用棒球手套接住的話，那該有多好？」

Then one day she decided: “That’s it, I need a break. I’m too tired. No more résumés today — today I’m going to Tianmu Baseball Stadium to catch a game.” She settled into her seat in the stands, watching the game. Someone hit a towering fly ball, an outfielder took off running, and every pair of eyes was locked on that ball in the air. And in that exact same moment — a shooting star streaked across the sky. Whoosh. Gone, just like that. Too fast. She’d seen it, but before she could even think of a wish, the star had already vanished. “Oh no,” she thought, “what a waste — if only I’d had time to wish on that one! So close, and I missed it.” And then: “Hmm… what if there was a way to get a notification before a shooting star appeared? Wouldn’t that be wonderful?” Just then she watched the outfielder track down the fly ball and snag it clean in his glove. And she thought: “Wow… what if a shooting star came at you just like a fly ball, and you could catch it with a baseball glove too? Wouldn’t that be amazing?”

第 二 章 Chapter II
4

三III
奇怪的販賣機The Strange Vending Machine

然後呢，棒球比賽結束之後她就要回家嘛，但是邊走回家的路上邊想說：「啊，剛剛流星有許願就好了。」結果呢，走著走著看到：「欸，路邊怎麼有一台奇怪的販賣機？」她就走近一看啊，發現裡面怎麼賣的是能幫助你許願接流星的棒球手套。欸，這不是她剛剛在想的東西嗎？她就覺得很神奇。然後她一看售價呢，哇，居然一個只要十塊錢！她就覺得：「哦，不然來投投看十塊錢，看看會不會買到這手套好了。反正大不了就十塊錢被吃掉嘛，但是也才十塊錢而已，沒什麼大不了的。」她就投了一個十塊錢，然後一轉，咚咚，手套居然掉下來！哇，居然真的用十塊錢就買到一個手套耶！

After the game, she headed home, still thinking: “Ah, if only I’d gotten to make that wish.” And then, as she walked — “Wait. Is that… a vending machine on the side of the road? A really weird one?” She walked up and looked closer, and couldn’t believe her eyes: the thing was selling baseball gloves that help you wish on and catch shooting stars. Hang on — isn’t that exactly what she’d just been thinking about? It was uncanny. Then she checked the price: ten NT dollars each. “Well… I guess I’ll give it a shot. Worst case I’m out ten bucks, no big deal.” So she fed in a coin, turned the knob — clunk, clunk — and out dropped a glove. Wow. Ten dollars, and she actually got one!

第 三 章 Chapter III
6

四IV
手套開機了The Glove Wakes Up

她就把這個盒子帶回家呢，她就把這個盒子打開呢，發現裡面有一條充電線，然後有一張說明書，還有一個手套。她就把手套拿起來，戴到手上，結果這手套自動就開機了！然後自動掃描她的指紋，自動幫她創帳號，然後還自動幫她預約距離她最近的一顆流星——居然就在12月31號晚上23點59分，會出現在陽明山！

She brought the little box home and opened it up. Inside: a charging cable, an instruction manual, and the glove itself. She picked it up, slipped it onto her hand — and the glove powered on all by itself! It scanned her fingerprint, created an account for her, and went ahead and booked the nearest shooting star just for her — December 31st, 23:59, on Yangmingshan.

第 四 章 Chapter IV
8
/
五V
陽明山的倒數Countdown on Yangmingshan

她就收到這個通知之後呢，她就準備：「好，當天那個時間那個地點，她一定要去許願，一定要去接流星。」然後她就時間到了，她就在那個地方等嘛。結果呢，手套發出那個倒數計時：「3秒，2秒，1秒！」她抬頭一看，哇，果然流星出現了！她就趕快許願說：「拜託讓我投履歷找工作有公司回我，然後呢，順利面試通過！」然後許完願之後呢，手往天空一伸，那個流星就啪一下掉到她的手套的正中央，她就接住流星了！哇，許願也順利，也把流星接住。然後她就把那顆流星呢，裝進一個小玻璃瓶裡面，然後放在她包包裡面，當作她的護身符。

Once that notification came through, her mind was made up: on that day, at that time, in that exact place — she was going to be there. She was going to make her wish. She was going to catch a shooting star. The moment arrived. She stood waiting in the dark. And then the glove began counting down: “3… 2… 1!” She looked up, and there it was — a shooting star blazing across the sky! She rushed her wish out: “Please, please let companies reply to my résumés, and let me sail through every interview!” The second she finished, she reached her hand up toward the sky — and the star landed, whomp, right in the center of her glove. She’d caught it. Wish made, star in hand, all at once. She carefully tucked the little star into a small glass vial, slipped it into her bag, and carried it with her as a good-luck charm.

第 五 章 Chapter V
10

六VI
這家公司在做什麼？What Does This Company Do?

後來呢，很快就有公司約她面試囉。然後她就去跟面試官啊，自我介紹啊，然後呢，相談甚歡，然後回答問題又對答如流，很順利，她當場就被錄取了！然後呢，她錄取之後她就很開心嘛，但是她就突然發現一件事情，就是她不知道這家公司在做什麼耶。她就問了一下，她就問面試官說：「這家公司在做什麼呀？」然後面試官就說：「欸，你不知道嗎？我們公司在做的就是——幫助大家許願之後接住流星的棒球手套呀！」

Sure enough, before long a company called her in for an interview. She sat down with the interviewer, introduced herself, and the conversation just flowed — answer after answer, smooth as anything. They hired her on the spot. She was over the moon — but then suddenly it hit her: she had no idea what this company actually did. So she asked: “By the way… what exactly does this company do?” And the interviewer smiled: “Oh? You don’t know? Our company makes — the baseball gloves that help people wish on and catch shooting stars.”

故事完 The End

願每一份投出去的履歷，
都能接住屬於自己的那顆流星。 may every résumé you send out
catch its own shooting star.
